headline.en: UNI's 6% weekly bounce on $6.6M volume masks unresolved net inflation and crowded retail longs below the $5.96 DAO anchor.
headline.zh: UNI 周涨 6% 却仅 $6.6M 成交，掩盖净通胀未解与散户多头拥挤，价格仍在 DAO $5.96 锚定价下方。

keyChanges.en: 7d price +5.94% but 24h volume only $6.63M against a $2.5B cap — ~0.26% turnover; the rally is technical, not participation-driven.
keyChanges.zh: 7 日价格 +5.94%，但 24h 成交仅 $6.63M，对应 $2.5B 市值换手率约 0.26%——反弹属技术性回补，无真实承接。

keyChanges.en: Net emission still +1.92%/yr: $11.62M annualized buyback burns only 2.88M UNI vs 20M UNI issued. The burn narrative does not cover the printer.
keyChanges.zh: 净通胀仍为 +1.92%/年：$11.62M 年化回购仅销毁 2.88M UNI，对冲不了 20M UNI 的年度增发，销毁叙事跑不赢印钞。

keyChanges.en: Binance perp L/S account ratio 1.73 with 0% funding — retail is crowded long without paying carry; textbook long-flush setup, not a squeeze.
keyChanges.zh: Binance 永续多空账户比 1.73，funding 为 0%——散户零成本拥挤做多，属典型多头待清洗结构，而非轧空结构。

contrarianObservation.en: Two live temp checks — Activate v4 Protocol Fees and Robinhood Chain fee expansion — could plausibly 2-3x annualized protocol revenue if both pass, flipping the net-inflation math outright. The tape is not pricing this governance pipeline at all.
contrarianObservation.zh: 两个 temp check 正在同步推进——Activate v4 Protocol Fees 与 Robinhood Chain 费用扩张——若双双通过，年化协议收入有望翻 2-3 倍，直接反转净通胀账目。当前盘面完全未 price in 这条治理管道的价值。

watchNext.en: Outcome of [Temp Check] Activate v4 Protocol Fees — direct lever on buyback size and net-inflation flip.
watchNext.zh: [Temp Check] Activate v4 Protocol Fees 投票结果——直接决定回购规模与净通胀能否翻转。

watchNext.en: Progress on Robinhood Chain fee expansion — a net-new revenue surface outside mainnet/Unichain.
watchNext.zh: Robinhood Chain 费用扩张进展——主网与 Unichain 之外的全新收入面。

watchNext.en: Any real-yield / staker-distribution RFC filing to replace burn — the true regime-shift trigger for DCF repricing.
watchNext.zh: 是否有 real-yield / staker 分红 RFC 被提出以替代销毁——从 PE 估值切换为 DCF 估值的真正规制转换触发。

fullReasoning.en: UNI printed +5.94% on the week but on $6.63M daily volume against a $2.5B cap — roughly 0.26% turnover, effectively no participation. Any rally on this liquidity profile is technical, not thesis-driven. The fundamental picture has not moved: annualized protocol revenue of $68.36M funds an $11.62M buyback burning 2.88M UNI per year, while emission remains 20M UNI per year. Net inflation is still +1.92% at current price. Spot sits 32% below the $5.96 DAO treasury-burn anchor — the market is telling the DAO its own fair-value mark was wrong, and no cash-flow mechanism has been introduced to change that. Unichain TVL at $27M is another disappointment; the L2 was supposed to be the revenue accelerant and has failed to gather assets. Positioning is unhelpful: Binance perp L/S account ratio 1.73 with 0% funding means retail is crowded long without paying carry — a flush setup, not a squeeze setup. The one credible bull vector is governance: v4 Protocol Fees and Robinhood Chain fee expansion temp checks are both live. If both pass, buyback capacity rises materially and the inflation math could flip. But temp checks are early-stage — assume 6-12 weeks to enforcement, if ever. Trade the tape bearish-to-neutral over 1-4 weeks; treat a v4 fee pass as the only asymmetric long trigger.
fullReasoning.zh: UNI 周涨 5.94%，但 24h 成交仅 $6.63M，对应 $2.5B 市值换手率约 0.26%——本质无人参与。此流动性下的上涨属技术性回补，非基本面驱动。核心账目未变：年化协议收入 $68.36M，回购预算 $11.62M，年销毁 2.88M UNI，对应年增发 20M UNI，净通胀仍为 +1.92%。现价较 DAO 财库销毁隐含价 $5.96 折价 32%——市场明确否定 DAO 自设的公允价，且尚无任何现金流机制来重估。Unichain TVL 仅 $27M，作为收入加速器的 L2 严重不及预期。仓位结构也不利：Binance 永续多空账户比 1.73，funding 为 0%，散户零成本拥挤做多，属典型多头待清洗结构，而非空头轧空结构。唯一像样的多头论据在治理面：[Temp Check] Activate v4 Protocol Fees 与 Robinhood Chain 费用扩张同时在推进，若均通过，回购规模有望显著放大，翻转净通胀账目。但 temp check 属早期阶段，从投票到实际生效至少还需 6-12 周，且未必成行。1-4 周维度按偏空至中性交易，仅把 v4 费用开启视为唯一的非对称做多触发。
